name: TC-TYR-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Tyres
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/Tyres.cy.js#UtilityPages - Tyres [en] — Tyres TC-TYR-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Tyres
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TYR-03
**Title:** Lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Tyres
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Tyres page, open the lead form via "View September Offer", fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tyres page
2. Click a tyre card's "View September Offer" button to open its lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
